question: What is your return policy?
answer: We offer a 30-day return policy for all unused products in their original packaging. To initiate a return, contact our customer support team with your order number. Refunds are processed within 5-7 business days after we receive the returned item.

question: How long does shipping take?
answer: Standard shipping takes 5-7 business days. Express shipping (2-3 business days) is available for an additional fee. Free shipping is available for orders over $50. You can track your order using the tracking number provided in your shipping confirmation email.
keywords: shipping, delivery, how long, transit time

question: Do you offer warranty on products?
answer: Yes! All our products come with a minimum 1-year manufacturer warranty. Extended warranty options (2-year and 3-year) are available for purchase at checkout. The warranty covers manufacturing defects but does not cover physical damage or water damage.

question: How can I track my order?
answer: You can track your order by logging into your account and visiting the 'My Orders' section. Alternatively, use the tracking number from your shipping confirmation email on our tracking page. You can also contact our support team with your order number for status updates.
keywords: track, order status, where is my order, tracking number

question: What payment methods do you accept?
answer: We accept all major credit cards (Visa, MasterCard, American Express), PayPal, Apple Pay, Google Pay, and bank transfers. All payments are processed securely with SSL encryption. We also offer installment payment plans for orders over $500.
keywords: payment, credit card, paypal, pay, payment methods

question: Can I cancel or modify my order?
answer: Orders can be cancelled or modified within 1 hour of placement. After that, if the order hasn't been shipped yet, please contact our support team and we'll do our best to accommodate your request. Once an order has been shipped, it cannot be cancelled but can be returned after delivery.
keywords: cancel, modify, change order, update order

question: Do you ship internationally?
answer: Yes, we ship to most countries worldwide. International shipping rates and delivery times vary by destination. Import duties and taxes may apply and are the responsibility of the buyer. Please check our shipping page for specific country availability.

question: How do I contact customer support?
answer: You can reach our customer support team through: 1) Live chat on our website (24/7), 2) Email at support@techpro.com (response within 24 hours), 3) Phone at 1-800-TECHPRO (Mon-Fri 9AM-6PM EST). For fastest response, we recommend using live chat.
keywords: contact, support, help, customer service, phone, email

question: What is your price match policy?
answer: We offer a price match guarantee within 14 days of purchase. If you find a lower price from an authorized retailer, we'll match it. Contact our support team with proof of the lower price. Some exclusions apply for marketplace sellers and clearance items.
keywords: price match, lower price, price guarantee, cheaper

question: Do you offer student or military discounts?
answer: Yes! We offer a 10% student discount with a valid .edu email address and a 15% military discount with valid military ID. These discounts can be applied at checkout and cannot be combined with other promotional offers.
keywords: student discount, military discount, education, special pricing
